data.body: DD1 LATENT-DEFECT FOUND + FIXED (2026-06-05): cca8 DD1 added a second direct-push-to-staged site (_publish_rebased_branch via _SYNCED_VIA_REBASE) WITHOUT the staged-* guard that exists at _phase_source_branch_version_bump — so a mid-PR2 main-advance force-pushed staged-* and was rejected by the sub-PR ruleset (GH013), killing the promotion (hit live 3x). Tracked as bug e1bf-fccc-38b4-4d1f; fixed on 3ebb branch dd123-4 commit 9598f21fae (panel+convergence approved). cca8 must not close as DD1-complete until e1bf-fccc-38b4-4d1f is closed (fix lands with 3ebb).
